changes.title: Playtest comments
items: While paused, save a comment with the exact moment and recent events in Download log. Builders can restore its latest comment on the same build.

changes.title: Art cache fingerprints
items: The treehouse can reuse saved pictures after creature drawing updates.

changes.title: Crash log
items: The playtest log now keeps the last 20 errors, with their stack, build, game time and island.
